title: Label
description: One line of evals/labels/<batch>.jsonl. A human judgement on one trace for one failure mode (or overall). Files are append-only; a correction is a new line.

failure_mode.description: The failure mode labelled, or 'overall' for a whole-trace Pass/Fail from the review queue.

note.description: Free text from the annotator. Error discovery groups these into failure modes.

rubric_version.description: The failure-mode definition version the annotator was reading.

batch.description: The review batch this came from.
